insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Room rent eligibility/category is referenced but the specific limit/category is defined in the Policy Schedule, not in the wording. Pro-rata clause applies if higher room is chosen.

icu.note: ICU charges defined but no specific cap mentioned in wording; likely in Policy Schedule.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the base policy wording. Personal waiting period conditions may apply.

sub_limits.display: Robotic surgery capped at ₹1L (except specified types)
sub_limits.note: Robotic surgeries other than Total Radical Prostatectomy, Cardiac surgeries, Partial Nephrectomy, Surgeries for malignancies are capped at ₹1,00,000. Health check-up has a sub-limit per Policy Schedule. Annual health check-up sub-limit as per schedule.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned in base policy.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents covered from day 1.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 36 months of continuous coverage. No optional reduction mentioned.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) excluded for 24 months. Accidents covered from day 1; cancer after 30 days.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Booster Benefit: 50% of base SI added per claim-free year, max 100% of base SI. Reduced by 50% of expiring base SI if a claim is made.

restoration.note: ReAssure benefit: triggered by first paid hospitalisation or domiciliary/home care claim; unlimited restorations up to base SI per claim. Covers related and unrelated illnesses.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge for the same condition.

day_care.note: Day care covered if admitted for more than 2 hours; includes angiography, dialysis, radiotherapy, chemotherapy.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered subject to doctor's advice and continuous active treatment with daily monitoring.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered for hospitalisation of 24+ hours in recognised AYUSH hospitals.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses for organ harvesting covered when insured's transplant claim is paid.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance: ₹2,000 per hospitalisation. Air ambulance: up to SI for cashless, ₹2,50,000 for reimbursement, only in emergencies when hospitalisation claim is paid.

modern_treatments.display: Covered; robotic surgery sub-limited (₹1L except specified)
modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed including robotic surgery, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy etc. Full SI for specified robotic surgeries; ₹1,00,000 cap for others.

consumables.note: Safeguard covers List I non-payable items; Safeguard+ covers Lists I–IV. Both are optional paid add-ons.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatments in India only as stated in the preamble.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except for proven fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly premium mode. Coverage available during grace period for instalment policies.

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies only, not on renewals.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI norms with credit for waiting periods and no-claim bonus.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, OPD, hormone replacement therapy, sleep disorders, STIs (non-HIV), dental, external congenital anomaly, home medical devices

optional_riders.display: Personal Accident (AD/PTD/PPD), Safeguard (consumables + booster protection + SI inflation), Safeguard+ (enhanced consumables cover)
